title: Non-projective complete log canonical surfaces
summary: We construct non-projective complete log canonical algebraic surfaces whose canonical divisor is semi-ample over any algebraically closed field other than the algebraic closure of a finite field. We provide a unified framework to construct such surfaces for any given non-negative Kodaira dimension, namely, zero, one, or two. Furthermore, we give a relatively elementary proof, within the framework of the minimal model theory, of the essentially known fact that any complete log canonical surface with Kodaira dimension minus infinity is projective.
